binding_inventory.scope: direct whole-file hash records naming paths changed between the revisions; not transitive or line-span

review_resolved: independent review of 6355a379 (PASS; F1-F5 low); every finding is addressed in 414158e0 under Decision 0119, which amends Decision 0118 in place (item 5 wording, REPLACE and recursive triggers, the two newly tested rules)

components.review_fixes: the store authenticates writers by its key and a key holder is trusted as the owner (F1: module comment, Decision 0118 item 5, AMR-04.6 and AMR-04.6.1 rows); every operational store connection turns recursive triggers on and verify_runtime_configuration refuses one without them, and INSERT OR REPLACE on ledger roots, entries and heads is refused (F2); tests for an append naming another head and a root whose first digest differs (F3); the AMR-04.5 row names Decision 0118 and Decisions 0115/0116 point to 0117 (F4); lease tests retry only busy after a release, boundedly (F5, test-only)
components.AMR-04.6.2: shells/host/src/runtime_transport.rs (RuntimeJobStatus, RuntimeJobControl, crate-only RuntimeClientScope, JobControlUnavailable, job_status/control_job/control_job_for_client); shells/host/src/native_chat_runtime.rs (factory take_job_ledgers); shells/host/src/coding_development_runtime.rs (hands over the composed store's job ledgers); shells/host/src/coding_live_runtime.rs (begin_job before dispatch, terminal owner observation from the verified outcome, ledger-decided cancellation only, suspension/resumption/direct cancel refused); shells/host/src/runtime_ipc.rs (wire 7: job status and job control, no direct cancel; client scope derived from the authenticated peer); shells/host/src/cli_runtime.rs (cancel_run: status and control naming the observed revision, bounded stale retry, direct cancel only without job control; job state read before release); shells/host/src/coding_development_client.rs (job state and control answers on standard error in both formats)

mutation_checks: run before the source commit with private tooling, each applying one mutation and running the package filter: 13 mutations each made exactly its expected test fail and no other: recursive triggers off with and without their check (engine), and eleven AMR-04.6.2 rules (suspension reaching the ledger, direct cancel of a ledger job, resuming a cancelling job, a new run reusing a job, any cancelled run reported as observed, the outcome observation dropped, pid left out of the client scope, control decided without the derived scope, no stale retry, fallback to direct cancel on any job error, a status for another request digest accepted). The review's surviving S7 and S9 mutants now each fail the new F3 tests. The F5 change is test-only and was not mutated. These runs are not retained logs
failure_comparison: linux 188 passed, 19 failed, 51 ignored and host 353 passed, 52 failed, 10 ignored; both failure name sets are identical to the batch 9 source-check baseline; every new test passes
